causal-2x2.svg.selection: One pre-change 600s run per cell, all shown.

causal-final-repeats.svg.selection: Every final slot; digit denotes repeat. C1 Q/U are an explicitly reused pre-cleanup pair; other slots are post-cleanup. No averaging of p99.

causal-stage-times.svg.selection: D repeat1 for each source, independent distributions; never add percentile differences into contributions.

causal-d-resources.svg.selection: D repeat1, chosen by ordinal not performance. One-second OS samples and asynchronous five-second backlog observations. Input age starts at logical SEND, not DB commit.

causal-same-message.svg.selection: Partial-late logical SEND with largest recipient latency; illustrative worst case, not typical latency.
